views.rationale: Total net sales decreased 2% or $5.4 billion in 2019 versus 2018
Other operating expense (income), net rose to $68 million in Q3 2019 from $55 million in Q3 2018
Operating margin fell to 0.4% in Q3 2019 from 10.7% a year earlier
Third‑quarter 2019 sales fell $752 million, a 6% decline versus Q3 2018
Revenue grew 20% YoY to $40.5 billion, with constant‑currency growth of 22%.
Worldwide sales rose 0.2% to $61.3 billion, with operational growth of 2.9% offset by a 2.7% currency headwind.
Reported sales jumped $3,992 million, a 133% increase YoY, driven primarily by the merger.
Microsoft's operating income increased 280 basis points to 24.1% of net sales in the third quarter of 2019.
